name: ai-stack-mapper
description: Discover local AI agents in a codebase and publish them to Vault AI Governance Auto Discovery.

commands.title: AI Stack: Publish Local Agent Discovery to Vault

aiStackMapper.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python 3 interpreter used to run the scanner (must be 3.8+).

enumDescriptions: Name an agent whenever a file path looks AI-related. Broad, and prone to promoting prompt-only files to agents.
Find exposed routes, tasks and commands, and keep only those whose import closure reaches a real LLM client. Falls back to gated path inference for code no entry point covers.
aiStackMapper.agentDiscovery.markdownDescription: How local agents are discovered. `entry-points` produces fewer, better-evidenced agents, but changes each agent's `external_id` — everything already staged in Vault will re-key on the next publish.

aiStackMapper.scanOnSave.description: Automatically re-scan (debounced) when a relevant file is saved.

aiStackMapper.riskFailOn.description: Severity threshold used in the generated local AI risk report status. Risk data is not published to Vault.

aiStackMapper.riskUseLLM.description: Not supported in this Vault local-agent package: the risk scan is static-only and enabling this makes 'AI Risk: Scan Workspace' fail with an explanatory error.

aiStackMapper.vaultBaseUrl.description: Vault backend base URL used by 'AI Stack: Publish Discovery to Vault'.

aiStackMapper.vaultOrg.description: Vault Org header / tenant account id used by 'AI Stack: Publish Discovery to Vault'.

aiStackMapper.vaultRepoUrl.markdownDescription: Pins the repository URL used when publishing. This value determines each agent's Vault `external_id`. Leave empty to resolve it from the checkout's git `origin` remote, which is the recommended setting — the publish command does not accept a typed URL, because inconsistent spellings stage duplicate agents. Set this only when the git remote is not the right identity.

aiStackMapper.vaultBranch.markdownDescription: Pins the branch metadata sent to Vault. Leave empty to use the current git branch. Branch is metadata only and does not affect agent identity.
